title: Clarity?
body: My endocrinologist requires dexcom clarity when I visit and when I call for help. I see there is an option to log into clarity but can't get it to work? what's the 10 digit serial # it keeps asking for?

comments.body: The ten character number is from your receiver. This will allow you to upload to Dexcom Share.  However, at this point there is no way to upload xDrip+ to Clarity.

I was getting clarity and share confused. any word on clarity integration?
